elements_selected.content: HTML sanitiser using the `ammonia` Rust crate with an allowlist config mirroring OWASP recommendations per SPEC-034 REQ-3421. Deny `<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<object>`, `<embed>`, `<base>`, `<meta http-equiv>`, `<link rel=preconnect|dns-prefetch|prerender>`, all event handlers, `javascript:`/`data:`/`vbscript:` URIs in href/src, `srcdoc`/`formaction`/`ping` attributes, MathML `<script>`, SVG `<script>`, CSS `@import`, HTML5 `<template>`. Allowlist: standard CommonMark rendering output. Ship config at `tools/sanitiser-config.toml` for operator visibility. Fuzz-test against OWASP XSS cheatsheet and the `audit-diff-corpus` (task-cap-audit-diff).
